title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment: Netting Custody Credits and Goodwill
content:
Compensation the company owes the customer is netted against the closing payment on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job: **when custody credits stand on the job, the goodwill on the job belongs to that damage settlement, and the closing payment is reduced by every custody credit and every goodwill adjustment credit on the job; when no custody credit stands and at least one goodwill adjustment credit does, that goodwill is a courtesy on the customer's own charges and never relieves the carrier, the customer's own charges being the lines billed to customer, card surcharge lines and late fee lines, and the closing payment is reduced by the lesser of those goodwill credits and the customer's own charges; otherwise nothing is netted.**

| Custody credits on the job | Goodwill adjustment credits on the job | Reduction of the closing payment |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | any | every custody credit plus every goodwill credit |
| none | at least one | the lesser of the goodwill credits and the customer's own charges |
| none | none | nothing |

The customer's own charges are the storage and declared-value coverage lines billed to customer, the card surcharge lines and the late fee lines on the job.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- Custody credits 210.00 and goodwill 40.00: reduction 250.00.
- No custody credit; goodwill 90.00; own charges 65.00: reduction 65.00.
- No custody credit; goodwill 30.00; own charges 65.00: reduction 30.00.
